summary: Tabit markets itself as a "MobileFirst POS" operating system for hospitality, with a product suite spanning mobile ordering (Tabit PAD), kitchen management (Tabit Chef), guest experience, analytics, kiosk, gift cards, and hotel integrations, targeting full-service restaurants, restaurant chains, and hotel restaurants.

Tabit's own site lists reference customers including Roots Southern Table, KFC (via Yum! Brands International), 400 Gradi International, and 3rd & Ferry Market, with operations spanning the US, Europe, Israel, and Australia. (Scope note: Vendor-listed reference customers; scope of deployment (single location vs. chain-wide) not specified.)

Third-party company-profile aggregators identify Barry Shaked as Chairman/CEO and Nadav Solomon as Co-Founder/President, with Tabit described as a Series B company founded in 2014, headquartered in Rishpon, Israel, with roughly 224 employees. (Scope note: Sourced from secondary company-profile aggregators, not confirmed directly on Tabit's own leadership page; treat as directional only.)
